These are the concrete formats registered by the current export runtime. Product availability comes from the product profiles.

“Built in” means the application has a native writer for that format. “FFmpeg runtime required” is conditional: the table does not promise that the FFmpeg runtime can be loaded in every build or environment, or that an arbitrary replacement runtime contains the listed encoder and muxer.

Project files and label files are listed separately in [Project and label files](/reference/generated/project-files/).

## Audio

| Format | Extension | Codec / container | Fidelity | Maximum channels | Runtime requirement | Products |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AAC / M4A | .m4a | aac / M4A | Lossy | 8 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: aac; muxers: ipod or mp4) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| AIFF | .aiff | PCM / AIFF/AIFF-C | Lossless | 32 | Built in | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| BW64 / ADM | .wav | PCM / BW64 | Lossless | 32 | Built in | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| Broadcast WAV (BWF) | .wav | PCM / BWF | Lossless | 32 | Built in | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| Custom FFmpeg | Chosen at export | Custom / Custom | Depends on settings | 32 | FFmpeg runtime required; settings determine the encoder and container | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| FLAC | .flac | flac / FLAC | Lossless | 8 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: flac; muxers: flac) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| MP2 | .mp2 | mp2 / MPEG audio | Lossy | 2 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: mp2; muxers: mp2) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| MP3 | .mp3 | libmp3lame / MP3 | Lossy | 2 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: libmp3lame; muxers: mp3) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| Ogg Vorbis | .ogg | libvorbis / Ogg | Lossy | 8 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: libvorbis; muxers: ogg) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| Opus | .opus | libopus / Ogg Opus | Lossy | 8 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: libopus; muxers: opus or ogg) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| WAV | .wav | PCM / WAV | Lossless | 32 | Built in | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| WavPack | .wv | wavpack / WavPack | Lossless | 8 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: wavpack; muxers: wv) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |

## Video

| Format | Extension | Codecs / container | Runtime requirement | Products |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MP4 | .mp4 | h264 video; aac audio / mp4 | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: libx264, aac; muxers: mp4) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
| WebM | .webm | vp9 video; opus audio / webm | FFmpeg runtime required (encoders: libvpx-vp9, libopus; muxers: webm) | Soundscaper, Framescaper |
